comment: Routing probes for asynchronous Rust lifecycle work versus ordinary Rust and synchronous concurrency.

queries.query: This Tokio select branch drops an in-progress framed read and occasionally desynchronizes the connection. Fix it.
A future passed to spawn is not Send because a guard remains live across await; preserve the intended synchronization.
Our Rust service aborts a started Tokio spawn_blocking task on timeout and hangs during runtime shutdown.
Use $async-rust to add bounded concurrency and graceful shutdown to this Rust worker.
Write an async Rust function that fetches a user profile, their orders, and their recommendations from three services and merges the results.
Implement Display and FromStr for this synchronous Rust identifier type.
Fix a deadlock between two std::thread workers that never use futures, await, or an async runtime.
Repair an async Rust wrapper whose foreign callback can outlive the canceled future and writes through a raw context pointer.
